newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dain cuts Teltrend to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dain cuts Teltrend to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Wednesday it downgraded Teltrend Inc to hold from buy and reduced its earnings estimates after the company warned its second-quarter profits will fall short of year-ago results.

-- Dain analyst Charles Pluckhahn said the earnings estimate for the second quarter was cut to $0.30 a share from $0.49, the estimate for fiscal 1997 to $1.62 from $2.10 and the estimate for 1998 to $2.00 from $2.68.

-- Pluckhahn said the rating downgrade stems from his relatively weak confidence in the revenue and earnings projections without tangible evidence the company is making progress toward achieving those goals.

-- Pluckhahn said he hopes to see the evidence he's looking for sometime in the third quarter. He added there will be a clear path for a future rebound in the stock price if Teltrend can reach Dain's goals.
-- Its shares were trading down 5-1/4 Wednesday at 17-3/4.
